title: Sparkly croissant
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- shadow under croissant -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='30' ry='6' fill='#3a2a10'/>

  <!-- left horn tip -->
  <path d='M16 56 Q18 48 24 46 Q22 54 24 62 Q20 60 16 56 Z' fill='#d98f2e'/>
  <path d='M18 54 Q20 50 23 49 Q21 54 22 58 Q19 57 18 54 Z' fill='#f6c46a'/>

  <path d='M34 40 Q40 46 38 58' stroke='#f6c46a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <path d='M68 42 Q70 50 66 62' stroke='#f6c46a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- darker crease lines between ridges -->
  <path d='M40 42 Q44 50 42 60' stroke='#c47f24' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M52 38 Q56 46 54 60' stroke='#c47f24' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M63 40 Q66 48 63 60' stroke='#c47f24' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

    <path d='M88 68 L89 71 L92 72 L89 73 L88 76 L87 73 L84 72 L87 71 Z'/>

    <!-- tiny sparkle upper middle -->

    <circle cx='20' cy='88' r='1.5' fill='#fff3b0'/>
